`lbpair-openai-usdc.hex` is the **real** on-chain data (904 bytes, hex) of the Meteora DLMM LbPair account
`4HTy7aTjPm5PTSEws2yWRDPX6gjWM6sC2dV5mv9u8JsH` (OPENAI PreStocks / USDC), captured from Solana mainnet-beta at slot
448786149 on 2026-09-20. It is extracted from `packages/meteora/test/fixtures/openai-usdc-mainnet.snapshot.json`.
It exists to prove the layout offsets in `src/meteora.rs` against a real account, not a hand-built one.
